responsibility: Provides the Darwin-specific D frontend target hook initializer. It defines D builtin version identifiers for Darwin/OSX/Posix, answers D target-info queries with Mach-O as the object format, and sets Darwin-specific section names used by the D runtime metadata (__minfodata and its linker start/end symbols). Unlike the generic Darwin target files, this file is only about D language frontend hooks and metadata-section naming.
